ranking: Direct Boolean condition carriers: measured same-source native compiler and operation evidence; implemented in accompanying slice.
Repeated immutable field reads and comparison carriers: 1.45x string-membership source ceiling, unchanged-source prototype only 4–5%; not yet product evidence.

Managed eval sparse-list/type-index representation and tracing: recurring cross-workload samples, but expected graph algorithms must be separated from emitted overhead. Dense private CLI carriers cannot be substituted across an exposed managed ABI without proof.
limits: Exclusive sample groups from matched compiler wall windows are not whole-run percentages or per-function speedups. J snapshots are inclusive and cannot be summed with exclusive samples. J diagnostics timeout and are not conformance passes; the unchanged RegExp literal timeout received 284.09 CPU seconds near its original 300 s wall limit.
